* '''Errata 2, July 2022 full face''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 2)]]): the [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/hires/endorewokvillage.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z. * '''Errata 3, current full face''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 3)]]): the [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/hires/endorewokvillage.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-12-12T00:40:28Z; the pixel-identical [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c GIF copy] was committed 08:04:04Z that day. * '''Errata 4, current published partial''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 4)]]): December 2022 sheet edition; the cutout omits the artwork window and prints E1. It retains the supported <code>208_23</code> mapping. The same partial occurs in the June 2023 Set 8 sheet: the two official PDFs contain byte-identical embedded JPEGs and identical mask streams, so this repeat is one image state.<ref>[[:File:PC-Errata-December-2022.pdf|Official Errata Sheet, December 2022]], page 5. The cover and footer print the month edition; the exact publication day is unknown. The source filename’s 19 December date comes from PDF build metadata and is not established as a publication date. [[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf|Official Set 8 sheet, June 2023 edition]], page 7, image xref122 and mask121.</ref>
